segments.name: Marketing & Distribution
segments.evidence: We report our results of operations in three operating segments which are also reportable segments: • Marketing & Distribution sources fruit from growers and then distributes the fruit through our global distribution network; • International Farming owns and operates orchards from which the vast majority of fruit produced is sold to our Marketing & Distribution segment.
